title: A request through that client while the process has a tracer provider and a trace-context propagator registered and the environment asks for debug logging and another host
assertion: One request, to the API's own host; no span is started; no `traceparent`, `tracestate` or `baggage` header and no header outside the gateway's set is sent; nothing is written to the console; the request carries API version `2026-10-21` and the key as `Authorization: Bearer`, with no `X-Api-Key`; a client left at the SDK's default does trace and log (the control)
noFileReason: A fake fetch answers a synthetic message in memory; no request leaves the process; no file.
